Parity §23: Mochi Link trade VALIDATION only (5% ESTIMATE); no network trade, no PvP battle, no facility mode. If Mars wants online play, that is a new scale decision, not a gap silently filled.

checksHave: Both sides must offer a creature (aSpeciesId and bSpeciesId non-empty)
Receiver already owns that creature ID (receiverRosterIds includes offeredId)
existingHaveInCode.checksHaveCount: 2/2 in code; GardenView 'Check Mochi Link' button calls it and notes 'no network trade in pass 1'; BagView Give disabled ('no trade or held-item system exists to give to yet')

pvpShapeNote: No PvP battle shape is staged here beyond validation: local link-battle would reuse the turn-based battle system, which is a separate slice. Do NOT claim PvP exists.

stagedValidationChecks.rule: Both sides offer a creature instance ID; empty offer = error.
Receiver roster must not already contain the offered creature instance ID.

Offered speciesId must be in the Mochiichao roster (001-046, 331). Species 147/148 (Dorowani/Gabu) are RESERVED and fail validation until their stats land (Mars-only blocker). Discoverable slots 047-146 have no species and always fail.

Mythic Form creatures: trade legality NOT decided in any source. Field held as decision-owed; validator must NOT silently allow or block until ruled. (Garden Form itself is palette/aura on the same species and does not change speciesId, so it does not affect species legality.)
Level must be a positive integer. NO cap invented here: MAX-LVL cheat clamp 50 is a cheat code, NOT a trade legality cap — do not conflate them. Cap decision owed to coordinator/Mars before wiring.

Pokemon-baseline party shape: max 6 per side (Pokemon party size, brought over literally per parity order). Mochiichao party-size enforcement in code not verified in this clone — confirm against gameStore before wiring.
The two offered instance IDs must differ; a creature cannot be traded to itself / both sides offering the same instance = error.
Eggs: Pokemon baseline allows egg trading in later games, but Mochiichao has NO egg system in code yet, so no egg-trade rule is wired. Held as decision-owed until breeding lands.

tradeOfferShape.returns: string[] errors; empty = valid (same contract as mochiLinkValidate — extended, not replaced)
